When optimizeReport has no scan yet, the item is notChecked for that part (do not fall back to ES numbers silently). Template (storefront) part unchanged. Legacy shops: unchanged.
- Listing endpoint: GET /seo-checklist/pages?type=emptyImageAlt&pageType=files|collection|blog&cursor= (controllers/seoChecklistController.js, storeScan.listStoreIssuePages today reads ES): for V25 shops serve these three pageTypes from the GCS inventory, 20 rows per page, cursor = offset string, rows shaped like today's rows (title, url = Shopify admin link for the owner or the file, image, missingAltCount: 1, missingAltImages: [url]). Keep the old ES path for legacy shops. Read the frontend consumer (packages/assets/src/hooks/modal/useModalChecklistPages.js) so the row shape still renders.
